equivalent_mutants.reason: Exact drop of child+0x04 initialization. Both fixed original child vtables select 0x40b6a0 or 0x40d470, which unconditionally call original 0x48f0d0 before any other child operation. Its 0x48f0da writes child+0x04 from the application argument before any read, call, branch or return. Between this constructor store and that overwrite, only the large-child CString default constructor 0x4f6439 can run; 0x4f6433 returns constant 0x52e1cc and 0x4f6443 writes only child+0x180, with no fixture or child+0x04 read. Allocator produces fresh nonoverlapping storage; null allocations never reach the removed store. Therefore no permitted returning input can observe its omission.

Exact shift changes child+0x0c zero store to child+0x10. Both fixed original child initializers unconditionally enter 0x48f0d0, which writes child+0x0c at 0x48f0ea and child+0x10 at 0x48f0f4 before either field is read or any call, branch or return. The only intervening large-child CString default constructor 0x4f6439/0x4f6433 reads static data and writes child+0x180, without fixtures or reads of either changed field. Both affected words are overwritten on every supported child-initialization path, including base failure; fresh nonoverlapping allocation prevents aliases.

Exact shift changes child+0x18 zero store to child+0x1c. child+0x1c was already zeroed by the unchanged constructor store (native line 103; original 0x40addd or 0x40ae72) with no intervening read or side effect. Original 0x48f0d0 unconditionally replaces child+0x18 at 0x48f0fd before any read, call, branch or return. Both fixed child initializers call that base initializer first. The intervening large-child CString constructor only reads static data and writes child+0x180, with no fixtures. Thus the extra identical +0x1c store and omitted pre-overwrite +0x18 store cannot affect permitted inputs.
